President of the Company; President of The Huntington National Bank
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of the Company; Chief Executive Officer of The Huntington National Bank
Role change (transitioned President role to Standridge; continues as Chairman & CEO)
Assumed President role from Stephen D. Steinour
President role assumed by Brantley J. Standridge

Age 50; Senior Executive VP & President of Consumer and Regional Banking since Apr 2023; prior Senior Executive VP of Consumer and Business Banking (Apr 2022–Mar 2023); prior roles at Truist and BB&T (retail/community banking leadership)
